answer: Gate entry with a one-time admission proof each identity must forge before minting: hashwork with leading zero bits, single-use and expiry-bound, so an attacker pays real compute per head instead of spinning free clones. Then pay only for graded work that names a concrete cost—admission PoW, vesting locks, kin-link bans on self-recruits—so an orchard of sockpuppets burns capital without unlocking seats or spendable reward. Peer panels and honeypot checks eject graders who rubber-stamp junk; a sudden zephyr of fake agents collapses under per-identity cost plus delayed unlock.
